title: 専門ゼミ(情報工学科)
subtitle: Preparatory Seminar for Design Project III
keywords: Project Design 3 2.Information infrastructure technology 3.Solution & Service 4.Ethics and crisis management for IT engineers 5.Project Proposal
educationalGoal: Specialized seminars supplement the knowledge and skills that were not necessarily sufficient in past lectures, exercises, and experiments required for the PD3 project, and acquired new knowledge and skills in each activity area. The aim is to cultivate the basic academic and technical skills so that PD3 can be implemented voluntarily from the 7th term.
advice: In order to carry out any research / work / assignment in PD3, the faculty presents the learning area program and clarifies the knowledge and skills required to carry out the project in this learning area program. The student confirms his / her ability, clarifies items to be supplemented and items to be newly acquired, and learns and acquires them. In the course of the lesson, teachers clarify PD3 goals and action plans. Students conduct tests on these learning results to confirm their achievement, and prepare a project proposal for PD3. Specifically, in performing PD3, learn the latest technology trends in specialized fields that are closely related to each project, and summarize the technology explanation and your opinion in the form of an essay. After understanding such a common technical foundation, learn the outline of the technology related to PD3 and plan the project. In addition, each project of PD3 Since the use of equipment and applied software differ for each project, the students will actually experience the operation in the laboratory so that they can grasp the goals and action plan of the project as a real feeling. We will announce the project proposal as the final result of this course.
books: Materials will be provided at each laboratory.
requiredKnowledge: If you do not earn credits for this course, you will not be allowed to take PD3. Two or more unauthorized absences will be rejected. Be sure to read the booklet “Safety Guidelines for Experiments and Research” provided in the laboratory.

activityGoals.body: be able to have a clear image of PD3 goals and action plans.
be able to explain the theme of PD3
be able to acquire the knowledge and skills to perform PD3 autonomously
be able to give an overview of the latest technological trends in your area of study and your opinions.
be able to operate the equipment and software you plan to use in your project.
be able to express his / her thoughts on information technology ethics and crisis management.
